description: A first-person survival horror game where you crash on a wooded peninsula, build a camp and try to find your missing son while the locals hunt you. Gifts can make you jump, crouch, flick your lighter on and off or flip open the survival book at the worst possible moment.

guide.title: Get the game
guide.text: Install The Forest from Steam and play it through once so you know the controls and your save is set up.

guide.title: Point GiftDeck at the game window
guide.text: In GiftDeck, turn on "Bring a window to the front before pressing keys" and enter TheForest (the Unity window name; if it does not match, copy the exact title from Task Manager) as the window title, so key presses land in the game and not in your streaming software.

guide.title: Add your gift events
guide.text: Create one event per idea below and pick a gift for each. Start with cheap gifts for harmless keys and save bigger gifts for the chaotic ones. For example: a Rose presses Space to jump, a bigger gift toggles the lighter with L.

guide.title: Keep pranks survivable
guide.text: Avoid binding the sleep key (Z) or build-mode keys, which can waste resources. Opening the survival book (B) is a safe but annoying interruption.

warning: Keys come from the series' published controls, which were written for the first game. The game also has no in-game key remapping and no windowed mode, so test each event before you go live.
